lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: Aye, Padraig's still at his public house, and bedad, asking me a sixth time won't shift him an inch! Has a horse of yours cast a shoe, or are ye just fond of the sound of his name?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles, wiping soot from his brow with a rag.*
